host_admission.encoding: Each task records only its own allocation admission; no collective admission or queue deadline. Repeated physical hosts are retained and grouped by the reports.

interpretation: One separate fixed round. Every published call and adverse outcome is retained; earlier rounds are not pooled, replaced or removed. Allocations sharing a physical host are grouped across all retained blocks. Numeric, accounting and scheduler outcomes must be read together.

ordinary.call_span_encoding: Visit each run in cell order, warmups then block calls. Start at monotonic_origin_ns; add each start delta, then duration to recover the exact finish.
ordinary.fingerprint_encoding: Global ordinary.fingerprints array; worker_signatures use the same lossless intern table.
ordinary.host_score_binding: One median over every retained block score on each physical host. Replicas identify exact runs and their status in ordinary.runs; reference indices use block_score_references. The formal report determines eligibility.
